info.name: Employee Management API
info.description:
CRUD, pagination, search, and status-filter requests for the Employee Management API.

Successful responses keep endpoint-specific shapes: employee endpoints return an employee object, list returns a Spring Page object, delete returns 204 with no body, and health returns {"status":"UP"}. There is no success envelope.

Errors use {"timestamp":"...","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"Request validation failed","path":"/api/v1/employees","validationErrors":{"email":"must be a valid email address"}}. Invalid fields and query parameters are identified in validationErrors. Invalid enum values list the permitted values. Duplicate email returns 409; a missing employee or endpoint returns 404; unsupported methods return 405 with an Allow header; database unavailability returns 503; other database and unexpected server failures return 500.
